operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: conventions (money as text in major units, ids or names), today's trading day, the currency, tax classes, categories, registers, what your AI agent may and may not do, and ready-to-run recipes.

operations.name: app.status
operations.description: At a glance: set up or not, registers and their open shifts, open tickets (and how many your AI agent saved), products to review, imports waiting, kitchen orders open, products running low.

operations.name: setup.regions
operations.description: The country presets the first-run setup offers: currency, tax classes and rates, price mode, cash rounding.

operations.name: setup.complete
operations.description: First run: the business, its country preset and the owner with their PIN. Runs once. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: auth.me
operations.description: Who is signed in on this page (from its session), or null.

operations.name: auth.login
operations.description: Sign in with a PIN; returns a session token the page sends as X-Pos-Session. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: auth.logout
operations.description: End this page's session (lock the register).

operations.name: auth.first-pin
operations.description: Someone without a PIN (new, or cleared) chooses one and is signed in. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: auth.change-pin
operations.description: The signed-in person changes their own PIN. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: auth.approve
operations.description: A manager approves an action for the person at the counter with their PIN; returns a one-time approval (30 minutes) to pass as approval (or in approvals at finalize). Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

staff.description: The approving manager or owner (id or name)

scope.description: What it is for (shown in the audit trail)

operations.name: staff.list
operations.description: Staff with role, color, training mode and whether they have a PIN (PINs are never shown), plus what each role may do.

include_inactive.description: Include staff who were turned off

operations.name: staff.add
operations.description: Add a person with a role and their PIN. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: staff.update
operations.description: Change a person's name, role, color, training mode or turn them off. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

active.description: false turns them off (they cannot sign in)

training.description: Training mode: their sales are practice (not counted)

operations.name: staff.set-pin
operations.description: Set someone's PIN. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: staff.reset-pin
operations.description: Clear a forgotten PIN when the owner asks: the person chooses a new one at their next sign-in. Ends their sessions.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The shop's settings: business details, currency and decimals, price mode, tax rounding, cash rounding, order types, service charge, receipt options, kitchen, lock time, cashier discount limit, trading-day cutoff.

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change settings. Your AI agent may change only the business details and receipt wording (business_name, address, phone, email, website, receipt_header, receipt_footer); the rest is for the owner.

receipt_header.description: Text printed at the top of receipts

receipt_footer.description: Text printed at the bottom of receipts

tax_reg_label.description: Owner: label of the tax registration number (e.g. SST No.)

currency.description: Owner: currency (only before the first sale)

price_mode.description: Owner: prices include tax or not

cash_rounding.description: Owner: smallest coin cash totals round to, e.g. 0.05 (0 is off)

order_types.description: Owner: JSON list of dine_in, takeaway, delivery

default_order_type.description: Owner: the order type a new sale starts with

service_charge.description: Owner: service charge percent, e.g. 10 (0 is off)

service_charge_scope.description: Owner: on dine-in orders or all

service_charge_tax.description: Owner: tax class of the service charge (empty: untaxed)

receipt_barcode.description: Owner: print the receipt number as a barcode (scan it to find the sale)

after_sale.description: Owner: after payment, ask about a receipt, print one, or none

kitchen_enabled.description: Owner: send kitchen items to the kitchen screen

order_numbers.description: Owner: give each sale a daily order number

show_tile_prices.description: Owner: show each product's price under its name on the register's tiles

lock_minutes.description: Owner: lock the register after this many idle minutes (0 is never)

cashier_discount.description: Owner: biggest discount percent a cashier gives without a manager

day_cutoff_hour.description: Owner: hour (0 to 12) the trading day ends the next morning

operations.name: tax.list
operations.description: Tax classes with their rate, the rate when eaten in (if different), receipt mark, default, and how many products use each.

operations.name: tax.add
operations.description: Add a tax class. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

dine_in_rate.description: Rate when eaten in, if different

mark.description: Mark printed next to items, e.g. ※

operations.name: tax.update
operations.description: Change a tax class (past sales keep the rate they were sold at). Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tax.archive
operations.description: Archive (or restore) a tax class no product uses. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tenders.list
operations.description: Payment methods (cash, card, QR, other) with their QR image when they have one.

include_inactive.description: Include methods that are turned off

operations.name: tenders.add
operations.description: Add a payment method. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

ask_reference.description: Ask for a reference (last 4 digits, approval code)

qr_path.description: Absolute path of the QR image customers scan

operations.name: tenders.update
operations.description: Change a payment method (name, on or off, order, QR image). Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

qr_path.description: Absolute path of a QR image

operations.name: registers.list
operations.description: Registers with their open shift, if any.

operations.name: registers.add
operations.description: Add a register (code R2, R3... by default). Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

code.description: Code, up to 8 letters or digits

operations.name: registers.update
operations.description: Rename or archive a register. Owner only, at the counter; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: catalog.register
operations.description: Everything the register sells, in one call: categories, active products with variants, barcodes, stock and modifier groups, the modifier groups with options, and preset discounts.

operations.name: categories.list
operations.description: Categories with color, icon, kitchen flag and product count, plus the icons a category can use.

operations.name: categories.add
operations.description: Add a category.

kitchen.description: Its products go to the kitchen screen

operations.name: categories.update
operations.description: Change a category.

operations.name: categories.delete
operations.description: Delete a category; its products stay, without a category.

operations.name: categories.reorder
operations.description: Put categories in a new order.

categories.description: JSON list of category ids or names, in order

operations.name: products.list
operations.description: Products: search by name, SKU or barcode; filter by category, status and availability.

q.description: Part of a name, SKU or barcode

category.description: Category id or name, or none

limit.description: At most this many (0 for all)

operations.name: products.get
operations.description: One product with variants, barcodes, modifier groups, stock and the last 30 days of sales.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: products.add
operations.description: Add a product (with variants, barcodes, modifier groups, stock tracking).

category.description: Category id or name (empty for none)

price.description: An amount in the shop currency with "." as the decimal point, e.g. 4.50 (no decimals for JPY)

open_price.description: The price is typed at the counter each time

tax_class.description: Tax class id or name (default: the default class)

variants.description: JSON list replacing the variants, e.g. [{"name":"Regular","price":"4.50"},{"name":"Large","price":"5.50","sku":"LAT-L"}]

barcodes.description: JSON list replacing the barcodes, e.g. ["9555001234567"] or [{"code":"...","variant":"Large"}]

modifier_groups.description: JSON list of modifier group names or ids offered with it

cost.description: Cost per unit (for profit in reports)

color.description: Tile color slot 1 to 8 (0: the category's)

low_stock.description: Alert when stock is at or below this

operations.name: products.update
operations.description: Change a product; lists given (variants, barcodes, modifier groups) replace the current ones.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

category.description: Category id or name (empty for none)

price.description: An amount in the shop currency with "." as the decimal point, e.g. 4.50 (no decimals for JPY)

open_price.description: The price is typed at the counter each time

tax_class.description: Tax class id or name (default: the default class)

variants.description: JSON list replacing the variants, e.g. [{"name":"Regular","price":"4.50"},{"name":"Large","price":"5.50","sku":"LAT-L"}]

barcodes.description: JSON list replacing the barcodes, e.g. ["9555001234567"] or [{"code":"...","variant":"Large"}]

modifier_groups.description: JSON list of modifier group names or ids offered with it

cost.description: Cost per unit (for profit in reports)

color.description: Tile color slot 1 to 8 (0: the category's)

low_stock.description: Alert when stock is at or below this

operations.name: products.set-available
operations.description: Mark a product sold out (or back). Anyone signed in may do this at the counter.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: products.archive
operations.description: Archive a product (it stops selling; history keeps it).

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: products.restore
operations.description: Bring an archived product back.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: products.reorder
operations.description: Put products in a new order (on the register within their category, or within Favorites).

products.description: JSON list of product ids, in order

operations.name: products.approve
operations.description: Approve imported products (to review) so they sell. A person does this on the Products page; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: products.discard
operations.description: Throw away imported products that are still to review.

operations.name: products.import
operations.description: Add many products at once. Rows: [{"name","category","price","sku","barcode","cost","description","tax_class","variants":[{"name","price"}],"track_stock","stock"}]. Missing categories are created. What your AI agent imports waits for a person's review. All or nothing.

status.description: A person's import: active (default) or draft

operations.name: modifiers.list
operations.description: Modifier groups (Milk, Size, Add-ons...) with their rules (min, max) and options with prices.

operations.name: modifiers.add-group
operations.description: Add a modifier group with its options.

min.description: How many must be picked (0: optional)

max.description: How many may be picked (0: no limit)

options.description: JSON list, e.g. [{"name":"Oat","price":"1.00"},{"name":"Full","price":"0","is_default":true}] (prices may be negative)

operations.name: modifiers.update-group
operations.description: Change a modifier group; options given replace the current ones.

operations.name: modifiers.delete-group
operations.description: Delete a modifier group (it is removed from its products).

operations.name: modifiers.set-available
operations.description: Mark an option sold out (or back), e.g. oat milk. Anyone signed in may do this.

option.description: Option id, or its name with group

group.description: Group id or name (when option is a name)

operations.name: discounts.list
operations.description: Preset discounts offered at the counter.

operations.name: discounts.add
operations.description: Add a preset discount.

value.description: A percent like 10, or an amount like 2.00

scope.description: On the whole order or one item

operations.name: discounts.update
operations.description: Change a preset discount.

operations.name: discounts.delete
operations.description: Delete a preset discount.

operations.name: lookup.code
operations.description: What a scanned or typed code is: a product (and variant), a receipt, or nothing.

operations.name: stock.list
operations.description: Products that track stock, with what is on hand per variant; low and out counts.

q.description: Part of a name or SKU

operations.name: stock.history
operations.description: A product's stock moves (sold, refunded, received, adjusted, counted), newest first.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: stock.receive
operations.description: Stock in (a delivery).

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

variant.description: Variant name or id (required when the product has variants)

operations.name: stock.adjust
operations.description: Correct stock up or down with a reason (broken, expired, found).

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

variant.description: Variant name or id (required when the product has variants)

operations.name: stock.count
operations.description: Set what is on hand to what was counted.

product.description: Product id, SKU, barcode or exact name

variant.description: Variant name or id (required when the product has variants)

operations.name: imports.list
operations.description: Menu and price-list files for your AI agent to read, with their status and how many products wait for review.

operations.name: imports.add
operations.description: Add a menu photo, PDF or spreadsheet for your AI agent to read (it is asked at once).

operations.name: imports.start
operations.description: Your AI agent takes a waiting import.

operations.name: imports.complete
operations.description: Finish an import with a summary of what was added for review.

summary.description: What was added and what was left out

operations.name: imports.fail
operations.description: Mark an import as not readable, with a reason the user can act on.

operations.name: imports.retry
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to read a failed import again.

operations.name: imports.delete
operations.description: Delete an import file (products it added stay).

operations.name: tickets.list
operations.description: Open tickets (saved carts: tabs, orders to collect, orders your AI agent took), newest first.

operations.name: tickets.get
operations.description: One ticket with its lines.

operations.name: tickets.park
operations.description: Save the counter's cart as a ticket. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tickets.resume
operations.description: Open a ticket on a register. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tickets.release
operations.description: Put an opened ticket back to waiting, unchanged. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tickets.void
operations.description: Void a ticket with a reason (a cashier needs a manager's approval). Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: tickets.draft
operations.description: Save an order you took (phone, chat) as a ticket for staff to check and take payment. Lines name products by id, SKU, barcode or exact name, a variant and options by name; default options apply when none are named.

name.description: Ticket name, e.g. Phone order: Sam

customer.description: Customer id, phone, email or exact name

operations.name: sales.finalize
operations.description: Record a paid sale, refund or exchange: re-prices every line, checks the total, takes the payments and assigns the receipt number. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

ref.description: A unique ref for this sale, reused on retries

expected_total.description: The total the cashier showed, in minor units

operations.name: sales.preview
operations.description: Price a cart without saving anything: lines, discounts, service charge, tax per rate and the total. Use it to quote an order.

lines.description: JSON cart lines: [{"product":"<id>","variant":"<id>","qty":1,"modifiers":["<option id>"]}] (ids from catalog.register)

operations.name: sales.list
operations.description: Sales, newest first: search by receipt number, ticket name, customer or order number; filter by days, kind, register, staff, customer, payment kind.

q.description: Receipt number, ticket name, customer name or phone, or order number

customer.description: Customer id, phone, email or name

training.description: Training sales instead of real ones

operations.name: sales.get
operations.description: One sale with lines, taxes, payments, returns against it and the sale it returns from.

operations.name: sales.refundable
operations.description: What can still be returned from a sale, line by line.

operations.name: sales.receipt-text
operations.description: A sale's receipt as plain text with an email subject.

operations.name: receipts.email
operations.description: Email a receipt to a customer: asks your AI agent (receipt_email_requested) to send it from the user's email account.

operations.name: receipts.reprint
operations.description: Record a reprint and return the sale to print. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: shifts.current
operations.description: A register's open shift with its live X report (sales, tenders, expected cash), or null.

operations.name: shifts.list
operations.description: Shifts, newest first, with totals and the cash count of closed ones.

operations.name: shifts.report
operations.description: The X report of an open shift (live) or the Z report of a closed one (frozen at close).

operations.name: shifts.open
operations.description: Open a register with its counted float. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

float.description: The float: An amount in the shop currency with "." as the decimal point, e.g. 4.50 (no decimals for JPY)

counts.description: Or the float counted by note and coin: JSON {"<value in minor units>": count}

operations.name: shifts.close
operations.description: Close a register: the counted cash (or counts), the expected cash and the difference; writes the Z report and asks your AI agent for the day's brief. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

counted.description: Cash counted: An amount in the shop currency with "." as the decimal point, e.g. 4.50 (no decimals for JPY)

counts.description: Or counted by note and coin

note.description: Why the cash is over or short

operations.name: cash.move
operations.description: Put cash in, take it out (paid out) or drop it to the safe, with a reason (a cashier needs a manager's approval). Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

amount.description: An amount in the shop currency with "." as the decimal point, e.g. 4.50 (no decimals for JPY)

operations.name: kitchen.list
operations.description: Kitchen tickets being made and ready (or the last collected), with the all-day count of items to make.

operations.name: kitchen.board
operations.description: The customer board: order numbers being made and ready.

operations.name: kitchen.bump
operations.description: Move a kitchen ticket on: new to ready (called), ready to done (collected). Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: kitchen.recall
operations.description: Move a kitchen ticket back one step. Counter only: needs a person signed in with their PIN; your AI agent is refused.

operations.name: customers.list
operations.description: Customers: search by name, phone or email; with visits, spend and last visit.

q.description: Part of a name, phone or email

operations.name: customers.get
operations.description: One customer with their recent sales and favourite products.

customer.description: Customer id, phone, email or exact name

operations.name: customers.add
operations.description: Add a customer.

operations.name: customers.update
operations.description: Change a customer.

operations.name: customers.archive
operations.description: Archive (or restore) a customer.

operations.name: reports.summary
operations.description: Sales over trading days: net sales, collected, orders, average, items, discounts, returns, tax, gross profit; by day and hour; top products, categories, payment methods, staff, order types, discounts, taxes; and the previous period.

operations.name: reports.export
operations.description: CSV of sales, sale lines or payments over trading days (returned as text with a file name).

operations.name: audit.list
operations.description: The audit trail: sales, refunds, overrides, voids, cash, shifts, failed PINs and changes, with who did and approved them.

q.description: Text in the summary or reference
